metadata.title: Frontline Trades: High-Volume Entry Standards
metadata.notes: Focused on high-volume certifications for immediate workforce entry.

nodes.title: OSHA 10-Hour (General Industry)
nodes.description: Foundational health and safety awareness for industrial workers. Hazard recognition and avoidance. The universal requirement for warehouse and factory roles.

nodes.title: EPA Section 608 Universal Certification
nodes.description: Legal requirement for anyone maintaining, servicing, repairing, or disposing of appliances that contain refrigerants. Essential for climate control trades.

nodes.title: CDL Class B: Theory & Skills
nodes.description: Operating vehicles over 26,001 lbs that do not tow trailers. Essential for local delivery, buses, and service trucks.

nodes.title: ServSafe Food Protection Manager
nodes.description: High-tier food safety certification for kitchen leaders. Managing time, temperature, and contamination risks. Mapping regenerative nutrition to food safety.

nodes.title: ASE Entry-Level (Automobile) Mapping
nodes.description: Foundational knowledge for auto technicians. Engine repair, brakes, electrical systems, and maintenance. Linked to Scrap-stack Mechanics.

edges.rationale: Kinetic safety and tool mastery are the direct prerequisites for professional OSHA standards.
Water stewardship and plumbing intuition provide the context for closed-loop refrigerant systems.
Understanding the source-chain of soil health is the prerequisite for safe food management.
